description_en: Deletes a batch of custom lines by specifying their unique IDs
description_zh: 通过自定义线路唯一ID批量删除自定义线路
name: DeleteCustomLines

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. The default value is zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
